caveats: Rewards are ESTIMATES. Nothing has been paid or reconciled.
Fills are MODELLED from captured public trades with a conservative queue assumption; they are not observed fills of our orders, which do not exist.
REST snapshots have no sequence and no queue position, so execution modelling is the weakest part of this evidence.
Replay is faster than wall clock; all durations are STREAM seconds from captured timestamps.
A bounded capture cannot span complete incentive periods for long-dated markets; their reward figures are partial.
